$comment: Copy to local-values.json (gitignored) and fill in for this installation. See placeholders.json for what each one is and where to find it. bootstrap-nest.mjs reads this file and will tell you exactly which values it still needs.
$agentPrompts: Used by export-agents.mjs / restore-agents.mjs when tokenizing agent prompts.
$nest: Used by bootstrap-nest.mjs when installing the nest into ~/.buzz.
$channels: This community's channel UUIDs. Janice's routing table needs these resolved — an unresolved token here means she posts findings to a channel named after the token.
